src_meta.hist_hourly_key: location_id (ISO-NE market pnode); join via node_xref
src_meta.spine: bus_master.bus_id — union of every bus seen in any source
src_meta.key_policy: bus_id on: bus_master, bus, substations_corrected, headroom, generators, loads, lmp_hourly_fcst, constraints_* (source_bus_id/sink_bus_id), branches (from/to). lmp_hourly_hist keyed by location_id, join via node_xref. queue_projects has NO bus key (lat/lon + POI name only).
src_meta.fcst_hourly_horizons: 5yr (=2028 basis) and 10yr (=2035 basis) ONLY. 2040/2045/2050 exist at ANNUAL grain only.

agg_meta.pnode_policy: One representative pnode per bus: exact match first, then fewest buses sharing the substation, then lowest location id. 501 of 1,218 covered buses carry alternates; see bus_pnode.alternates.
agg_meta.peak_definition_hist: HE 8-23, Monday to Friday. NERC holidays not excluded.
agg_meta.fcst_calendar: study_day mapped to day-of-year within each run; months from a 365-day reference year.
agg_meta.duration_grain: 101 points, 0 to 100 percent of hours, richest first.
agg_meta.windows: solar = HE 10-16 (hours 9-15); wind = HE 1-7 and 19-24; flat = all hours.
